final.answer: The lowest stated numeric limit is GV-47-2: 6 bar for the PVC version at 0–40 °C. Along the path: E-7-2, E-26-1, E-45-1, E-45-2 and E-45-3 each have a maximum design pressure of 16.0 barg under PED or 10.3 barg under ASME; LV-7-1, BV-26-1, LV-26-1 and BV-45-1 have no single value stated, as it depends on configuration and temperature; P-26-1, P-26-2, P-26-3, P-45-1 and P-47-1 have a maximum operating pressure of 250 psi (and maximum casing pressure of 266 psi); PV-45-1 has no general valve maximum stated (104 bar is listed for a specific packing system); CHV-45-1 and CHV-47-1 have a stated series maximum working pressure of 6000 psig (413 bar). Because some valve limits depend on configuration, the datasheets do not establish an unconditional lowest value across every item.
